newsitem.title: USA: Unicom Q4 aided by reduced interest expense.
newsitem.headline: Unicom Q4 aided by reduced interest expense.

text.p: Unicom Corp said Friday a 10 percent reduction in interest expense and dividend requirements on preferred stocks contributed to its improved fourth quarter earnings over the same 1995 period.
Unicom said an extraordinary loss of $20 million after taxes, or $0.09 a share, was recorded in the 1995 fourth quarter for early redemption of debt.
Earnings per share rose in the quarter to $0.44 from $0.16. Operating revenues rose to $1.64 billion from $1.58 billion.

The company, parent of Commonwealth Edison Co, also said operation and maintenance expenses decreased six percent in the 1996 quarter compared to the same year-ago period. It said fourth quarter 1995 operations and maintenance expenses included a charge of $88 million related to voluntary employee separation plans, which reduced net income by $53 million or $0.25 a share.
Edison reported a nine percent increase in total kilowatthour sales during the quarter, principally due to increased sales to other utilities.
